basicOpcodeRules.boundary: Authored operations only. Stack effects require normal return, valid evaluation-stack storage and managed array indices. Conv_I8 selects the tag after resolveStackReference returns normally: Integer sign extension, Long no conversion store, Float widening followed by the same truncating Double-to-Int64 helper, or the runtime-exception route for other tags. The latter stores zero only if that call returns normally. Floating-point exception masks/state and child or alias effects are unobserved. Nop does not itself read its Operand, but Constrained may read the preceding instruction Operand. No patch loading or execution is observed.

virtualDispatchRules.boundary: Native control/data flow conditional on compatible values and normal helper returns. slotCopyRules.boundary: Selected paths require valid Value storage, aligned pointer differences, compatible managed array indexes and normal helper returns. All copy/store paths initially copy the 12-byte Value bits, then branch on the copied tag. ObjectClone.Clone identity and body are pinned, but its returned object and internal object relationships are unobserved. In the FieldReference store branch dst.Value1 is changed before src.Value1 is read, so overlapping source/destination needs runtime storage evidence. Stloc clears the consumed evaluation managed position after store returns. No stack height, runtime argument count, reference dereferencing, alias behavior, patch entry or execution is inferred.

negativeFieldRules.boundary: For selected negative static-field operands, -(Operand+1) chooses internal VM static-field arrays after checkCctorExecute. Ldsfld calls PushObject at top and advances one slot; Stsfld calls ToObject on top-minus-one with clone=true, stores its return, clears the consumed managed slot and removes one slot on normal return. Runtime contents/bounds, initialization/conversion success and execution stay unobserved. No file-table join or anonymous-storey framing is asserted.

instanceFieldRules.boundary: Selected negative instance fields use complemented Operand as AnonymousStorey field index. Ldfld replaces top-minus-one in place; Stfld converts top-minus-two, stores top-minus-one and rewinds top by two slots without explicit consumed managed-slot clearing. Storey helpers copy all12 Value bytes and transfer/rebase managed references only for tags at least Object. Get/Set address an unchecked field pointer from element zero and forward Type/VM into ToObject/PushObject. Runtime values, bounds, conversion, alias semantics, later cleanup, invocation and anonymousStoreyInfos file framing remain unresolved.

stackReferenceRules.boundary: This is a one-hop qword decoder for incoming StackReference, not a native pointer safety check or runtime stack interpreter. A non-null stored address is not validated by the native guard. The target Value snapshots are copied once and no recursive resolver call follows; Object and ValueType then select managed references using target.Value1 at the actual read. Managed destination position is signed pointer difference divided by12, truncated into an int32 Value1 and sign-extended for the managed index. Storage validity, actual pointed values, overlapping storage, helper mutation and Clone return identity remain unobserved. Null enters the stored InvalidProgramException message route, an opaque object helper, its named constructor, throwRuntimeException with wrap=true, and INT3; no normal-return tail follows. Existing Ldloca and UpdateReference proofs supply the common qword payload encoding, while existing Conv_I8 rules own conversion after normal resolver return. Other Execute callsites are inventoried only, not projected as validated input bindings.

slotAliasRules.boundary: Consequences require same complete 12-byte Value or distinct nonoverlapping Values, valid aligned slots and managed indexes, and normal helper returns without other Value/managed storage mutations. Source and destination can still share an incoming managed index. Self FieldReference store reads the rebased index; object selection precedes rebase. Stloc clears the physical source managed position after store. Partial overlap, live index relations, Clone identity, helper-induced mutation, recursive reference aliases and actual execution remain unresolved.
